details.description: moonshot-v1-32k was one of the original chat-completions models in Moonshot AI's moonshot-v1 line, the middle of three context-window tiers (8,192, 32,768 and 128,000 tokens) the company originally offered over a text-only endpoint. Moonshot AI's developer platform, now operating under the Kimi brand at platform.kimi.ai, discontinued the entire moonshot-v1 series on August 31, 2026 -- including moonshot-v1-8k, moonshot-v1-32k, moonshot-v1-128k, moonshot-v1-auto, and their vision-preview variants -- stating the models are no longer maintained or supported and directing developers to its current flagship model, kimi-k3.
advantages: Offered a larger 32,768-token context window than the series' moonshot-v1-8k tier, for longer text inputs, per Moonshot AI's own model documentation.
disadvantages: Moonshot AI discontinued moonshot-v1-32k, along with the rest of the moonshot-v1 series, on August 31, 2026, stating it is no longer maintained or supported and recommending kimi-k3 instead.
Text-only: no image input, unlike the series' own moonshot-v1-32k-vision-preview variant.
use_cases: General-purpose text chat completions needing more context than the 8k tier, as part of Moonshot AI's original moonshot-v1 conversational model line before its August 2026 retirement.

notes: Catalog's deprecation_date fact is empty for this target, but Moonshot AI's own Model List and platform changelog (both fetched 2026-09-24) state the entire moonshot-v1 series, including this model, was discontinued on 2026-08-31 and that calls to it now return a 404 error. Moonshot AI's current documentation gives no description of this model's capabilities beyond its name, context window and deprecation status -- no source describing function calling, JSON mode or language support for it specifically could be found, so none is claimed here. Context window (32,768 tokens) matches the catalog facts.
